guarantees.claim: tx is continuously assigned to the value of internal signal tx_q.

assumptions.claim: tx_q must be driven by other logic in the module; otherwise, tx will be unknown.
assumptions.risk: tx output becomes X, leading to undefined UART transmission and potential security exposure if unknown value propagates to pin.

uncertain_points.claim: Signals baud_div_q, tick_baud_q, bit_cnt_q, bit_cnt_d, sreg_q, sreg_d, and tx_d are declared but not read or driven in this region; they may be unused if not referenced elsewhere.
uncertain_points.risk: Dead code increases area/complexity without function; if accidentally omitted, functional gaps may exist.
